attempts.summary: PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication configured across the 3-node CentOS Stream 10 cluster: node1 is the writable primary, node2 and node3 are read-only hot standbys built via pg_basebackup with a dedicated replicator role. Data committed on node1 is confirmed visible on both standbys, and standbys reject writes. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time (standbys first, primary last) with confirmed boot-id changes and full post-restart recovery of PostgreSQL, replication streaming, and data.
